subject: general
question: Which of the following is a major risk associated with fuel spillage?
solution:
The correct answer is __Fire hazards and environmental contamination****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fuel spillage__ poses significant risks, including fire hazards.
 
• Spilled fuel can contaminate soil and water sources, leading to environmental degradation.
 
• It increases the risk of accidents and explosions in the workplace.
 
• Proper handling and disposal of fuel are crucial to prevent such risks.
 
• Regulations and safety measures must be followed to minimize fire hazards and environmental damage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Safety Precautions:**
 
 
• Ensure proper storage of fuel in approved containers.
 
• Install fire extinguishers and train personnel in their use.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Measures: **
 
 
• Clean up spills immediately using appropriate materials.
 
• Dispose of contaminated materials as per environmental safety guidelines.
